You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
In the context of the provided chest X-ray images, analyze the impact of the mediastinal mass on the patient's anatomy and identify how the surgical intervention altered this presentation. Which of the following statements best describes the changes observed in the chest X-ray images before and after the surgical excision of the mediastinal mass?

A) Before surgery, the mass displaced the heart to the left, but post-surgery, the heart returned to its normal position.
B) The trachea was initially deviated to the left due to the mass, but post-surgery, the trachea returned to midline position.
C) The right lung was compressed and shifted to the left by the mass, but post-surgery, the right lung re-expanded.
D) The mass caused bilateral pleural effusion, which resolved post-surgery.
E) Before surgery, the mass caused significant lymph node enlargement, which resolved after excision.
F) The mediastinal mass led to both heart and tracheal displacement, with realignment observed post-surgery.
